news.headline: Optimizely web experimentation flaw used to plant malware on 178 organizations' sites
news.summary: An attacker exploited a vulnerability in Optimizely's web experimentation platform to inject malicious JavaScript into its customers' websites, according to the company. The reported victims include 178 organizations, among them BBC, CNN and Zoom.
news.chaosTwist: Santa's elves were told to run experiments on the nice list, but someone slipped a rogue script into the stocking and every site got a lump of coal.

sources.title: Week in review: Java4Shell proves tricky to exploit, malware planted via Optimizely hits 178 orgs
